brief: A three-storey tower: drawers on the bottom storey and open bins on the top storey.

requirements.evidence: Full hex bases stacked at (0,0) on levels 0, 1 and 2 (snap links between each storey).
Two half bases on level 0 at (0,-1) and (0,1) (half-s, half-n), each carrying one drawer (drawer:0#0,-1#cut and drawer:0#0,1#cut). Joint bolts lock both halves to the central full base.

requirements.requirement: Open bins on the top storey
requirements.evidence: Open full-depth bin (bin:0,0,2~hex-bin-full) seated in the top-storey base at (0,0,2).

finish.summary: Built a three-storey tower: a central full-base column at (0,0) across levels 0-2, two drawers on the bottom storey (on half bases at (0,-1) and (0,1)), and an open bin on the top storey. check_build reports no errors, meshClash is clear; only info-level notes about uncapped open faces remain (caps were not requested).

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
